text_block_list.text:
As a light drizzle began to fall, I 
stopped by the training track—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Duration of top speed has been updated. 
Next is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, my, continuing your training, are we? 
Looking at the sky, it seems it's about to 
pour down.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Got nothing to do with you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How cold of you. I'm merely worried about 
you. Your race is coming up soon, is it 
not?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, cut the crap about being "worried." 
You're just plain curious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you're pulling out, just hurry 
up and go home. Don't get in my way.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Harsh as always. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, it's definitely slippery. Guess 
I'll re-verify my stride and footing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll need to advance the timing of my 
spurt as well...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wholeheartedly agree! Will your 
stamina run dry first, or will you reach 
the goal first?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps your limiter will break off 
first? A brand new awakening mid-race... 
fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
......All the numbers are within expected 
parameters. All that's left is making the 
body keep up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, you truly are a devotee of numbers. 
However, the body doesn't always perform 
as expected.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you are in a rush, I can offer you some 
wonderful things. Right here, I have 
Tachyon-brand—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh!! Shut your trap next to me, you're 
annoying! Weren't you supposed to be 
heading back?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, as a friend, I'm simply intrigued 
by your train of thought. What reason does 
a lover of logic have to expose themselves 
to wind and rain?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Especially when the forecast calls for 
clear skies for a while after this. Isn't 
running on this terrible track right now 
completely inefficient?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Unfortunately, I'm the type who 
trusts the data I calculate myself over 
predictions made by others.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Meaning... conditions will turn out 
like this in the race? Or did you receive 
a revelation to work through the mud and 
grime?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out. My theories are absolute. 
That's why right now, I'm thoroughly 
eliminating any "possibility" of 
deviation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, to be so obstinately clinging to 
your own conclusion! My, my, how truly 
passionate... or rather, fanatical.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet, without blindly believing a 
hypothesis, one cannot move forward... is 
that it? You truly are a researcher after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't lump me together with a romanticist 
like you. As long as I win, that's all 
that matters.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, when a realist goes too far, I'd say 
they are pursuing an ideal in their own 
splendid way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Look, just go home already! Or should I go 
leak every single bit of your research?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how scary, how scary. Having my 
top-secret research exposed would be 
troublesome indeed, so I suppose I'll take 
my leave.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way... feel free to leave your 
physiological data to me. I'll inspect you 
thoroughly... fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, as if I'd leave it to you. I know 
myself best.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now that the nuisance is gone, let's do 
this. Next is footfall intensity...
